name: io.github.Servosity/synology-mcp
title: Synology MCP
description: Active Backup for Business jobs and storage health from every client Synology NAS, in one database

environmentVariables.name: SYNOLOGY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: DSM address of the NAS with scheme and port, for example https://nas.acme.example:5001.

environmentVariables.name: SYNOLOGY_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: DSM account name used for the SYNO.API.Auth login.

environmentVariables.name: SYNOLOGY_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: DSM account password; sent only in the login request, never written to disk.

environmentVariables.name: SYNOLOGY_DEVICE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Trusted-device token from an earlier two-factor login, used instead of a one-time code.

environmentVariables.name: SYNOLOGY_OTP_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. One-time code for the first login of a two-factor account.

environmentVariables.name: SYNOLOGY_TLS_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. SHA-256 fingerprint of the NAS certificate to pin (DSM ships a self-signed certificate).

environmentVariables.name: SYNOLOGY_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to skip certificate verification; prefer SYNOLOGY_TLS_FINGERPRINT.

environmentVariables.name: SYNOLOGY_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Blank, 0, false, no or off keeps every tool; any other value removes every write tool.

environmentVariables.name: SYNOLOGY_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token callers must present when the server runs with --transport http; not used by stdio.

environmentVariables.name: SYNOLOGY_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent header the CLI sends to the NAS.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Not used by this connector (no tenant-gated client profiles); leave unset.
